title: Three kinds of eunuchs — two false readings first
english: On the difference among eunuchs. From [[there are eunuchs who were born so from the mother’s womb >> Bible:Matthew 19:12]] through [[let the one who can receive this receive it >> Bible:Matthew 19:12]]. Before the reading that seems true to us, we set out two false takes on the place and overturn them, so we may live better once we grasp the sense. Some, treating a third castration as bodily because the first two look bodily, rashly mutilated themselves from fear of God and drew shame even among outsiders to the faith. Others — not many — kept the first two bodily but took the third as cutting desire by the Word for the sake of the [[kingdom of the heavens >> Bible:Matthew 19:12]], scorning the body’s insults once the Word had cut desire.

title: Letter kills; sword parable warns literalists
english: Friends of the bare Gospel letter, missing that Jesus spoke these things also [[in parables >> Bible:Matthew 13:34]] and by the Spirit, leveled the third castration with the first two as bodily. Where [[the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:6]] elsewhere, say the same here: clinging to the letter on the first two killed those who took the third the same way. Need another New Testament case of a killing letter? Hear the Savior: when I sent you without purse and bag and sandals, did you lack? Now [[let the one who has no sword sell his cloak and buy one >> Bible:Luke 22:36]]. The one who buys a murderous blade by a bad reading dies against Jesus’ will. Glory to Christ. Amen.
